long.text: Learn to shape clay into something worth keeping, and build a small collection of my own finds in the house.
long.reason: Clay is good and so are things I have claimed, and I mean to have both in one place.

steps.reason: The bed is soft and it is night, so I will curl up here and let the wound-up feeling wear off.

today.reason: Sleep is refused until true night, and the other things I wanted are for daylight, so I will rest on the bed instead.
